key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut to toggle top bar visibility
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to hide or show the top bar and reclaim workspace area.

key.name: mouse-hover-reveal
key.summary: Auto-reveal top bar on mouse hover
key.description: Temporarily show the top bar as an overlay when the mouse reaches the top edge.

key.name: hover-delay
key.description: Milliseconds the mouse must hover at the top edge before the top bar reveals.
